svg.title: Built in the open, for Kansas
svg.desc: Illustrated footer: a prairie at dusk with twinkling stars, a grain elevator, a turning windmill and swaying grass along the horizon, with the line 'Built in the open, for Kansas. Explore the map, read the evidence, help build the frontier.'
